== frame after_reload cursor=9,28
|testuser@<HOST> ~ $ cd project
|denv: <HOME>/project/.envrc is blocked. Run `denv allow` to trust it.
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project * $ denv allow
|denv: allowed <HOME>/project/.envrc
|denv: loading .envrc
|denv: +DENV_TEST_VAR
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $ denv reload
|denv: loading .envrc
|denv: -DENV_TEST_VAR +DENV_TEST_VAR
|testuser@<HOST> ~/project $
